original.reason: The projections of disjoint open sets need not be disjoint. Also, normality alone need not imply Hausdorff, regular, or T1 under the stated assumptions.

judgment.reason: It assumes that a normal space is T1, which is not part of the stated assumptions/standard separation-only definition of normality. Thus the claimed closedness of the slice is unjustified.
It assumes normality implies T1, so its assertion that the coordinate-fixing slice is closed is unsupported.
The proof relies on the unstated implication normal => T1 in order to make the slice closed.
It incorrectly treats T1 as a consequence of normality under the theorem's stated assumptions; consequently closedness of the embedded slice is not established.
